bio.text: Mitchell Scoggins represents District 14 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was sworn in on January 14, 2019.
Scoggins was born and raised in Bartow County and began working for Bartow County government in the early 1980s as a firefighter.
He was elected Bartow County probate judge in 1988, took office on January 1, 1989, served seven unopposed terms and retired in 2016.
